title: Chapter 1029
text:
"Philip, destroy all traces of the calculations and the experiment report."

"Understood, hum …"

The experiment report on the screen disappeared. Han Xiao waved his hand and put away the virtual screen. He then turned around and looked at Aurora and Feidin behind him.

"Only the two of you know about this. Don't tell anyone else, or there will be trouble. Understood?"

"… Are you saying that someone like the Germinal Organization leader will appear?"

Aurora pursed her lips, and the painful memories of the past flashed through her mind. A look of fear appeared on her face, but it was replaced by determination the next second.

She believed that with Han Xiao and her sister by her side, she would not make the same mistake again.

"Hmm, if this matter spreads, it will attract the interest of many universe giants, and you will be in danger." Han Xiao nodded.

Hila's ability to shorten one's lifespan was something that Beyond Grade As feared, but Aurora's ability could make Beyond Grade As go crazy. Most Beyond Grade As were thinking of ways to extend their lifespans, even those with long lifespans were no exception. For example, if EsGod was still alive, he would definitely try to obtain Aurora's Esper Ability at all costs. His priority would be even higher than the Evolutionary Totem.

Not only the Beyond Grade As, even some advanced civilizations would be tempted. Aurora had entered the Calamity Grade, and the efficiency of her life energy production was very high. She could already heal people without worry. The civilizations would not treat her like how the Germinal Organization treated her, but they would at least put her under house arrest and make her continuously produce life energy potions.

This way, he would also be standing at the center of the storm, facing the covetous eyes of many Beyond Grade As. He had to be stronger than he was now to suppress the evil intentions of others. Aurora's ability was a double-edged sword, so before Han Xiao reached a higher level, he did not plan to reveal any information about Aurora. He did not plan to use her ability to build relationships with others.

Fu Ding nodded and said, "Don't worry, I've always treated Aurora as my sister. I won't let the news leak."

Han Xiao said a few more words to the two of them before letting them leave the room. He was the only one left in the room, and he began to ponder.

After Aurora advanced to the Calamity Grade, her connection with Hella had become even closer. From his perspective, they seemed to be forming a symbiotic relationship.

Now that Aurora had just advanced, she still needed to familiarize herself with her abilities. When she awakened the new ability to heal Hella from afar, the increase in Hella's strength would be extremely terrifying.

In his previous life, Hella had lost Aurora early on. Without the other end of the symbiotic relationship, she could only go crazy in the cold universe alone. The current Hella did not walk the path of endless slaughter, so her growth was much slower than in his previous life. In a one-on-one battle, she was definitely not a match for her previous self. However, with Aurora, this super-sized milk bottle that could ignore distance, Hella's combat strength would far surpass her previous self.

"Hella is probably going to catch up to me in terms of tankiness in the future …" Han Xiao was helpless. Hella had an Aurora Character Summon Card that could be used infinitely.

Super High Risk Esper Abilities were very powerful, and these two sisters could even form perfect cooperation and soul resonance. It was truly terrifying. Only psychic and spatial abilities could slightly suppress the life sharing connection between the two.

Han Xiao thought about it, turned on the communication channel, and sent a message to Ames, briefly telling her that Aurora had entered the Calamity Grade.

…

In the sky above Blue Star, Floating Dragon Island …

Ames did not participate in the competition in the Flickering World and remained in the Shattered Star Ring. She only allowed Floating Dragon to develop in a low-profile manner and not chase after opportunities.

Although she did not participate in the tide of the era, Ames was very familiar with the situation in the Flickering World. Han Xiao knew that Ames liked fun things, so he shared first-hand information with her every day, telling her what fun things were happening in the Flickering World every day to satisfy her curiosity. Ames watched with great interest at home, treating it as a daily pastime. Checking Han Xiao's news regularly had already become a habit.

In the bedroom of the palace, Ames leaned against the headboard, condensing her force field into a small ball, and teasing a white giant bear lying on the ground like she was teasing a kitten with a stick. It was clearly a ferocious giant bear, but it was extremely obedient in front of her, rolling around on the ground.

After Ames moved to Blue Star, Aurora had left the pets on the planet with Floating Dragon, asking her teacher to help take care of them as a pastime.

There was another person in the room. Jenny stood at the door, reporting on Floating Dragon's business situation. Even if Ames was not paying attention, she still read the report seriously.

"… The recent public opinion poll shows that thirty-nine percent of the Floating Dragon warriors are dissatisfied with the current situation, an increase of seven percent compared to the previous poll. Many of the warriors came for the title of Beyond Grade A, hoping to make a name for themselves under your command. However, for a long time, we lack the opportunity to fight, causing the hearts of the people to waver. Especially when we are not participating in the competition in the Flickering World, many of our subordinates are even more dissatisfied and lost a batch of warriors …"

Ames turned a deaf ear to him and continued to attack the bear with her force field.

Jenny coughed and continued. "Ignoring the trend of the times is not a wise decision. We should change our decision and step into the Flickering World …"

Ames raised her head, glanced at her, and chuckled. "Don't you dislike work? This is the twenty-second time you've tried to persuade me to enter the Flickering World. Why are you so enthusiastic now?"

"… Isn't this because you want to develop your organization?" Jenny stroked her hairline. Facing this boss who left all the work to her, she was filled with helplessness.

She hated heavy work, but Floating Dragon had gradually developed over the years, and she was not willing to let it go. She could not deliberately interfere with Floating Dragon's normal operations just to be lazy.

"As my subordinates, they should adapt to me, not me adapting to them." Ames did not mind and sighed. "If only Black Star was still under me, I wouldn't have to worry about anything."

"…" Jenny.

Her heart ached!

Ames ignored Jenny's twisted expression, waved, and said, "Anyway, you don't have to persuade me anymore. I won't go to the Flickering World. I have no interest in that place."

Jenny still wanted to say something, but at this time, Ames' communicator rang. She took it out, and her eyes sparkled.

"Black Star sent me a message again. Jenny, wait outside for a while."

Seeing this, Jenny could only swallow her words, turn around, and walk out of the room with a sour heart.

I haven't even finished my business, and just because Black Star sent me a daily message, you don't even want to listen to my important report …

I was the one who came first …

Ames did not care about Jenny and carefully read the message that Han Xiao sent her. Other than the news that he had shared today, there was also a piece of news that made her feel refreshed.

"Aurora has finally become a Calamity. My student is amazing." Ames was very happy.

At the end of the letter, Han Xiao also sent an invitation to visit Black Star Palace and meet Aurora.

"Go to the Flickering World …"

Ames hesitated.

If Black Star invited her, it was not impossible to go to the Flickering World …

How nice.

With that in mind, Ames called Jenny in.

"Prepare the spaceship. I'm going to the Flickering World."

"You've finally thought it through? I'll organize the troops immediately! "Jenny was overjoyed.

"What troops? I can go alone." Ames waved the communicator and smiled. "Black Star invited me to play."

Jenny was instantly expressionless.

Oh, I've been talking for so long, but it's useless. You go as soon as Black Star invites you.

So, this is what it feels like to have a change of heart …

At this moment, only one song could perfectly describe Jenny's current mood.

In the human world, who doesn't feel like a purgatory when they're alive …

…

Flickering World, free competition zone.

More than ten general-purpose spaceships flew slowly in the universe, carrying the guild players of Red Bay, Titan, Archipelago, and a few other famous clubs in Southeast Asia.

"Everyone, our next move is very important. It concerns whether we can quickly gain a foothold in the Flickering World."

In the meeting room, the captain of Red Bay, Viper, knocked on the table and said with a serious tone.

"Snake is right." Red Bay's veteran player, [Forest Python], agreed. He was once the captain of Red Bay, but because he was getting old, he took the initiative to give up his position to nurture the newcomers. Viper was the new captain who had replaced him last season.

"The Chinese players have a huge advantage now. Before the players of the other countries arrive, we should not provoke them and develop in a low-profile manner." Titan's captain, [Bangkok Buddha], analyzed. "However, the Chinese players are very forward-looking. Maybe we can imitate their playstyle and communicate with the NPC organizations."

The Chinese clubs had an unparalleled advantage in the free competition zone, and they had the help of a large number of NPC organizations. This group of Southeast Asian guilds naturally did not dare touch them and only wanted to gain a foothold and develop first.

Due to the army's system, the Chinese guilds had learned the efficient playstyle of Version 4.0 in advance, and the clubs of the other countries would naturally study it. Therefore, these Southeast Asian clubs also wanted to copy this playstyle.

"But it's not that easy." Someone hesitated. "The Chinese players can become a formal subsidiary organization because of the Black Star Corps' system, but our faction does not have such a system. We don't have the qualifications to be independent, so there's no way for us to become a formal organization."

The guilds of these large clubs had not jumped ship and belonged to the factions that they had once worked for in Blackhole Edge.

The other factions did not have the army's system, so if they wanted to become a formal organization, they could only leave the faction and become independent. Obviously, they did not dare to do so now.

Furthermore, these people were not free and had already been recruited by the faction. Before reporting to the faction's stronghold, these guilds only had a very limited amount of time to move around freely, completely incomparable to the freedom of the army players.

"The faction's Main Storyline Mission has already been released. We don't have much time left in the free competition zone. We have to find an opportunity quickly," Viper said.

They discussed and decided to use the method of casting a wide net.

Very soon, they ran into countless obstacles. They were not a formal organization and could only use the name of the faction behind them to pretend that they were a special team. Most of the organizations that they contacted directly rejected them. They were also foreign organizations, not local tyrants like the Black Star Corps. They were all competitors, and there was no need for them to take the risk.

As for the remaining forces, they were willing to listen to their requests on account of their strength. Although the scale of these Southeast Asian guilds was not comparable to large countries like China and America, if they worked together, they would still be able to gather a few thousand people.

As for Red Bay and Archipelago, because they were not independent organizations, they did not accept missions. They followed the agreement of the Chinese guilds and made requests for cooperation. Only then could they establish strongholds.

Hearing their requests, the organizations that were originally a little interested directly hung up the communication, not even bothering with them.

Viper and the others were very surprised and felt that this was different from what they had imagined. The Chinese players were clearly very successful, so why was it so difficult to communicate with the NPC organizations when it was their turn?

After studying for a long time, they finally understood what was going on. These organizations were looking down on them because they were not qualified to be partners.

The players of Red Bay and Archipelago were at most Star Cluster level civilizations, but in the current Flickering World, there were too many Star Cluster level civilizations.

The reason why the Chinese players were able to communicate with the various small organizations was because they shared the influence of the Black Star Corps. Many organizations were willing to share planets and cooperate with the Chinese guilds because they wanted to hug the thighs of the local tyrant, the Black Star Corps, to stabilize their strongholds so that other organizations would not dare to compete with them.

As for the other Star Cluster level civilizations, they naturally did not have such prestige.

These people were very helpless. Their factions were not strong enough, and it was very difficult to replicate the methods of the army players.

The more they understood the power of the Black Star Corps, the more they envied the Chinese players.

After putting in a lot of effort, these Southeast Asian guilds barely managed to establish a few small strongholds. They could not be compared to the army players at all. Following which, these Southeast Asian professional guild players hurriedly responded to the recruitment of the faction and worked for the faction, unable to move freely for the time being.

Even Red Bay and Archipelago, these first-rate guilds in Southeast Asia, had such a difficult start, not to mention the other Blackhole Edge players who had not joined the Black Star Corps. They did not have the capital to imitate the way the army players played and could only start like in the early stages of Version 4.0 in Han Xiao's previous life.

The Blackhole Edge players were the first batch to arrive, and after them, more Star Field players arrived. The situation quickly became complicated, and the World Server gradually took shape.

At the same time, Han Xiao had already arrived at the Emerald Star Cluster and hidden.

Han Xiao had made so many arrangements for the army, and his leek farm had expanded smoothly. He could be said to be a merciless, fully-automated harvester.

As more and more fresh leeks jumped to the Black Star Corps, his efficiency of gaining experience increased many times over in a short period of time.

When the number of Black Star Corps players increased to nearly eight million, he finally accumulated enough experience to reach level 320!
